name: Glare of the Annealed
source:
███ just got home. After a long day of uni, he just wanted to sit back and relax, watching the England vs. Mexico World Cup match. ███'s dad is already there waiting for him.

[From [url=https://lycartemis.itch.io/glare-of-the-annealed]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
███刚回到家。在大学里熬过了漫长的一天后，他只想瘫坐下来放松一下，看看英格兰对阵墨西哥的世界杯比赛。而███的父亲早已在家里等着他了。

[摘自[url=https://lycartemis.itch.io/glare-of-the-annealed]itch.io[/url]]
